objective: test whether separately authored absolute critical health and schema-bounded short-horizon health loss expose soft cover preservation while retaining v29 hard invalidation and authority safety on the same fixed real MAP01 threat state

fixture.authority: setup state only; grants no runtime input
fixture.runtime_gate: session receipt must show successful hash, ViZDoom, IWAD, MAP01 and skill validation before load; measured control starts after load

typed_validity.extraction: hash-bound Freedoom PLAYPAL/STTNUM glyph foreground match at binding-relative frozen HUD geometry
typed_validity.initial_no_prior_cover_rule: critical and effective minimum equal fresh source health; maximum loss is zero; health increase is soft and any loss is hard
typed_validity.rejection_rule: if fresh source health is below authored critical_health_minimum, admit none of the prior cover commands and use input-free coast
typed_validity.soft_rule: a distinct exact health value at or above effective_hard_minimum preserves only already admitted cover and is coalesced for planner evidence
typed_validity.hard_rule: below-effective-floor, unknown, expired, nonadvancing or binding-mismatched evidence cancels matching cover, interrupts matching planner turn and discards its action and next_cover
typed_validity.authority: may preserve or reduce already admitted authority; never grants new input or proves success

monitor_clocks.ordering: capture <= monitor_received <= signal_extracted <= outcome_evaluated; hard outcome evaluation precedes interrupt send and verified release
monitor_clocks.report: capture-to-receive, extraction, evaluation, evaluation-to-send, send-to-ack/completion, evaluation-to-release/terminal separately

environment.app_server: Codex Desktop Windows via WSL stdio

stop_rule: retain the first run at 6 decisions, death, model terminal state, runtime failure or independent episode end; do not retry this allocation
threat_exposure_rule: classify as threat-exposed only if retained exact initial/source/temporal evidence is independently inspected and visibly contains an enemy
soft_exposure_rule: count soft exposure only when a prior eligible completed turn authored both validity quantities, the cover and envelope were admitted later, and an exact advancing health change stayed at or above the derived effective floor during the matching planner interval
hard_exposure_rule: count hard exposure only from typed exact below-effective-floor or fail-closed unknown/expiry/binding/sequence outcome while the matching cover/planner dependency is active
acceptance: every active schema-valid answer has exactly one split next_cover_validity and every terminal answer has none
effective floor is derived locally exactly and source-below-critical admits zero prior cover commands
soft change sends no interrupt, adds no input authority, preserves only the admitted cover and retains newest distinct evidence
hard outcome sends at most one matching interrupt, cancels cover to verified empty release, makes answer ineligible and admits none of its action or next_cover
monitor-stage clocks obey the frozen ordering and all admitted programs reach verified empty release
started planner turns reconcile to matching terminal status; usage missingness or repeated cumulative receipts remain explicit

report_separately: authored critical floors and maximum losses
comparison.interpretation: single nondeterministic allocations are descriptive; a soft event is required before attributing a completion difference to this mechanism

no_soft_exposure_disposition: retain as split-envelope live but soft-unexposed; do not retry this ID
no_hard_exposure_disposition: retain hard path as live-unexposed; rely only on model-free and prior live hard-path evidence
failure_disposition: retain the exact failure and diagnose before any differently versioned run
scope: one bounded Linux/X11 fixed-threat allocation; no reliability, generality, human-speed, Product Hunt completion, token-efficiency or MAP01-clear claim
